inputClasses: Inspection {artifactHash, buildHash, revision, scenarioId, actor, actorVersion, rubricHash, timestamp, findings, verdict, scoring?}
invariants: records are append-only files (0001.json, 0002.json, ...) and never advance the project revision
a duplicate record warns INSPECTION_DUPLICATE and keeps one file; an uncertain verdict warns and blocks completion downstream
a stale expectedRevision is a conflict; verdict maybe and a malformed artifactHash are invalid requests; the directory keeps exactly the records already written
a dry run writes nothing; handlers never write evidence.json
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
excluded: elevating command qualification (an inspection record alone cannot)

mutants.description: testInspectionRecordIsAppendOnlyAndNeverAdvancesRevision: a stale revision, an invalid verdict and a malformed hash must be rejected without adding files; the revision must never advance.
testHandlersNeverWriteTheEvidenceRegistry: no handler source may write evidence.json or the packs directory.

ExportQACLITests.testCLIDriverRunsQARunAndInspectionRecordEndToEnd: through the CLI driver inspection record must exit 0 with a 64-hex recordHash and leave the revision at 0 while build without a recipe exits 3.

A report envelope claiming every QAPackTests test passed (executed 11, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/QA/QAPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: inspection record is an append-only attestation write and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
